statement: Participants with chronic motor-complete spinal cord injury achieved voluntary over-ground walking with lumbosacral epidural stimulation combined with intensive locomotor training.

measurement.effect: over-ground walking achieved in some participants

replication.note: Two unaffiliated groups (Louisville; Mayo) reported the same category of result in the same year.

limitations: months of training and a specialised setting
spared descending fibres cannot be excluded

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
